verdict.rationale: The only relevant evidence is a community report that Ollama has shipped ROCm containers since 0.1.27, which suggests first-party container images exist. Nothing in the first-party docs covers container deployment, image tags, GPU passthrough or reproducibility practices. missing for 10: first-party documentation of official container images, usage/configuration instructions, GPU (CUDA/ROCm) container guidance, version-pinning for reproducible deployment, hands-on corroboration of container runs

support.subject: As a developer, I can run the runtime inside a container for reproducible deployment

citations.quote: They have shipped ROCm containers since 0.1.27.
